exposure: Traditional management (amniodrainage and/or emergency preterm cesarean delivery)
cohort: 46 monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies complicated by twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) after 26 weeks gestation treated with fetoscopic laser surgery, compared with 39 cases managed with traditional management
finding: Fetoscopic laser surgery for MCDA twins complicated with TTTS between 26 and 31 weeks gestation is associated with a higher gestational age at birth and better perinatal survival than traditional management.
